parameters.name: AttackPathAssetList
parameters.description: List of cloud product assets in the attack path.

parameters.name: PathName
parameters.description:
Path name.

> You can call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query the path name.

parameters.name: PathType
parameters.description:
Path type.
> You can call [ListAvailableAttackPath](~~ListAvailableAttackPath~~) to query the path type.

parameters.name: WhitelistType
parameters.description:
Whitelist type. Values:

- **ALL_ASSET**: All assets
- **PART_ASSET**: Partial assets

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas create-attack-path-whitelist --attack-path-asset-list AssetType=0 InstanceId=i-8vb0e8qdaj0yyxjo0000 NodeType=start RegionId=cn-hangzhou Vendor=0 AssetSubType=0 --path-type role_escalation --path-name ecs_get_credential_by_create_login_profile --whitelist-type ALL_ASSET --remark test --whitelist-name test --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas CreateAttackPathWhitelist --region cn-hangzhou --PathType role_escalation --AttackPathAssetList.1.NodeType start --AttackPathAssetList.1.RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AttackPathAssetList.1.Vendor 0 --AttackPathAssetList.1.AssetSubType 0 --WhitelistType ALL_ASSET --WhitelistName test --PathName ecs_get_credential_by_create_login_profile --AttackPathAssetList.1.InstanceId 'i-8vb0e8qdaj0yyxjo0000' --AttackPathAssetList.1.AssetType 0 --Remark test
